Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

flstockpile 0.1.0

  • First version: stockpile_stocks(), stockpile_sources(), stockpile_values() and stockpile_indices() read the dataset tables, and stockpile_flstock() converts the values for one stock to an FLStock.

  • The package is renamed from FLStockpile to flstockpile, to match its repository, which has moved to ices-tools-prod/flstockpile. The option that sets the dataset location is now flstockpile.url.

  • Stocks with no FLStock submitted, such as those in data category 5, can be taken from the catches, landings and discards published in SAG. The new origin column of stockpile_stocks() and stockpile_sources() is "SAG" for these, and stockpile_flstock() returns them as an FLStock with no ages.

Developed by Colin Millar, Neil Campbell.
